reference: Daskin, M. S., Snyder, L. V., & Berger, R. T. "Facility location in supply chain design." Logistics Systems: Design and Optimization (2005).
description: This internal OR-CPT SupplyChain generator creates a sparse declared directed network with supplier nodes, customer nodes, optional transshipment nodes, arc capacities, fixed activation costs, and unit flow costs. It is a fixed-charge capacitated network-flow model, not an inventory, multi-period storage, complete-graph routing, or warehouse-opening model.
math_formula:
### Mathematical Model
Let N be nodes and A be the declared sparse directed arc set. Each node i has supply s_i and demand d_i, with total supply equal to total demand. Each declared arc (i,j) in A has capacity cap[i,j], fixed activation cost f[i,j], and unit flow cost c[i,j]. Binary variable y[i,j] indicates whether declared arc (i,j) is activated. Continuous variable x[i,j] is flow on declared arc (i,j). Minimize sum_((i,j) in A) f[i,j] y[i,j] + c[i,j] x[i,j]. Capacity-linking constraints require x[i,j] <= cap[i,j] y[i,j] for every declared arc. Flow balance at every node requires sum_{(j,i) in A} x[j,i] - sum_{(i,j) in A} x[i,j] = d_i - s_i. Variables y are binary and x are nonnegative continuous. No arcs outside A may be created.
natural_language_example: A supply chain planner must choose which declared directed transportation lanes to activate and how much product to ship on each activated lane. Supplier nodes provide available supply, customer nodes require demand, and other nodes may act as transshipment points. Each listed lane has a fixed activation cost, a per-unit flow cost, and a capacity. The goal is to minimize fixed lane activation plus variable shipping cost while satisfying all customer demand, respecting supplier availability, and conserving flow at every node using the sign convention inflow minus outflow equals demand minus supply.
local_modification_notes: Internal OR-CPT version records a compact sparse directed arc set, per-arc capacity/fixed/unit cost tables, node role and balance tables, latent feasible flow certificates, and flow-balance guardrails for faithful LLM reconstruction.
